description: OMENZ Loadout Check: will this job loadout (Agent Skin or robot loadout like HOST MODE, PERSONAL TRAINER, RECEPTIONIST) run on this robot or agent? Provider-neutral capability words vs the platform profile (ROS 2 via ros-mcp, Unitree G1/Go2 via unitree_sdk2, digital MCP agent, OMENZ sim, or your own manifest): READY / DEGRADED / NOT_COMPATIBLE per capability and workflow, add-ons to install, safety-declaration gaps (e-stop, speed, no-go zones, contact), and what a human must confirm. Deterministic. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/loadout/check, $0.01 via x402.)

loadout.description: preset id (GET /v1/loadouts) or an omenz.loadout.v0 object

platform.description: platform profile id or a custom {id, native, addon} manifest
